Themes & Emotional Palette:
Deeply personal and introspective, centering on addiction, remorse and despair. The emotional tone oscillates between heartfelt sorrow, hopeful longing, and nihilistic despair, evoking feelings of guilt, loneliness, and desperation. The recurring motif of battling inner demons and seeking redemption underpins the narrative.

Word Choice, Imagery & Motifs:

Sparse yet potent diction, utilizing everyday language infused with intimate confessional imagery. Recurrent motifs include lost girlfriend, real friends, drugs dependency (Speed, Snow,Powder), heaven and hell symbolism, and illness metaphors. Visual imagery such as falling tears, and photo/video memories reinforce themes of regret, loss.


Persona, Vocal Style & Artist Signatures:
The persona is a tormented, self-aware individual, vulnerable and candid about flaws and failures. Vocal delivery is intimate and pleading, often with melodic inflections and slow, deliberate pacing that heighten emotional weight. Signature signatures include raw honesty, self-deprecating humor, and a blend of rap cadence with melodic singing, conveying a sense of conflicted sincerity and mental fragility.

Genre: "Introspective hip hop, Detroit rap, confessional rap" Instruments: "Mournful piano, minimal acoustic guitar loop, sparse boom bap drums, subtle vinyl crackle, melodic doubled vocal layers" Tags: "78 BPM; melancholic; intimate; gritty; emotional"

[Intro | hushed vocal | soft minor-key piano | distant vinyl crackle]
I keep these Polaroids, stashed in a torn up drawer  
Snapbacks, sweatpants, man, I wore ‘em all before  
Used to call you, drunk at three, just to say I missed your laugh  
Now I’m sittin’ in this kitchen, starin’ at a medicine glass  
Cold floor, bare feet, feelin’ sick, time just drags  
Talkin’ to my phone screen, voice cracks, beggin’ you back  
Photos playin’ like a loop I can’t fast-forward, stuck in rewind  
Old friends dipped, new numbers in my contacts, but none reply  
Heart’s in the freezer with my stash, locked, can’t break the ice  
My mama’s eyes said, “You’re killin’ yourself,” but I can’t get it right

[Verse 1 | intimate confessional rap vocal | piano & acoustic guitar loop | minimal drums | low-mixed melodic hums]
Swear to God, I ain’t lookin’ for sympathy,  
Never cared if you pity me,  
Self-loathing’s the only shit that fits me,  
Swallow these tabs like breakfast, history,  
Ripped through bags, ziplocks and secrecy,  
Life in a shoebox, love in a memory,  
Fucked up the recipe, nothin’ left for me,  
Fell for the remedy, ended up dead to me,  
Nights blend together, white lines and weather,  
Textin’ your name just to delete the letters,  
Every “I’m sorry” gets stuck in my throat,  
Feelin’ contagious, contagious, I know  
Scratched out a note, then I tossed it,  
Promises broken, exhausted,  
Photos of us in the closet,  
I talk to the past, it just mocks it,  
Damn, used to laugh ‘bout forever,  
Now it’s whatever,  
Callin’ your phone just to hang up,  
Pretend I’m better  
Never been clever, I’m stuck on the same shit,  
Hands shakin’, heart racin’, face it  
I hate it,  
Tryna erase it with powder and fake friends,  
Wake up with strangers, same bed  
Prayin’ for patience,  
Feelin’ contagious,  
I’m sick of these changes,  
Pill bottles, pages,  
Circle of faces,  
All of ‘em vacant,  
Nobody waits,  
So I fill up the space with replacements  
I chase it,  
Speed in my veins, it’s amazing  
My stomach’s in knots, I can taste it  
Crashin’ and crashin’,  
Tryin’ to mask it  
I laugh at the past, but it’s tragic  
I panic,  
She left me on read, now I’m frantic  
The devil keeps smilin’, romantic  
Takin’ these chances,  
Wishin’ I planned shit  
Tryna make sense,  
But it’s senseless  
Addiction’s a sentence,  
I’m trapped in  
Red eyes in the mirror, can’t stand him  
Hated myself for abandonin’  
Everything good that I had and  
If I could call you, I’d ramble  
I’d stammer and mumble and scramble  
But I can’t handle the answer  
So I vanish,  
Slip through the cracks like a phantom  
Goddammit,  
Swearin’ I’d quit, but I’m stranded  
Chasin’ a fix I can’t manage  
I panic  
Livin’ with damage,  
Wishin’ you’d bandage  
I vanish  
Photos in hand, but they vanish  
Feelin’ so famished,  
Still, I can’t stand it  
Try to remember your laughter  
But it just vanishes  
It just vanishes  
It just vanishes  
It just vanishes  
And I vanish

Genre: "conscious hip hop, rap ballad, Detroit boom bap" Instruments: "moody piano loop, minor-key strings, live bass, sparse trap hats, raw male lead, multi-layered harmonies" Tags: "78 BPM; somber; confessional; minimal; emotional punch"

[Intro | spoken intro | cracked voice | low piano and vinyl hiss | intimate delivery]
You want the truth? (Yeah)
I got a couple bags of it, zipped up, stuffed in a drawer
Can’t sleep, can’t breathe, still sniffin’ lines off a Polaroid floor
Chasin’ a face I forgot, but she’s still in my phone, still got her laugh on record
Funny how I’d give anything just to fast-forward this pain, but the tape’s stuck, rewindin’ remorse

[Verse 1 | confessional rap | melodic undertone | close-mic vocal | minimal beat]
Wake up, headache, stomach’s tight, last night’s mess on the kitchen tile
Couple missed calls, mom’s pissed, she sayin’ “You’re wild,” like I’m thirteen and high
It’s the same script, same pit, different day, different pile
Tryna dial in a reason to care, but I can’t, so I lie, say I’m fine, but I’m fried

I used to have a crew, real friends, now it’s me and the mirror, both cracked
My girl left, said she couldn’t handle the weight, and honestly, I get that
Blame it on the powder, the pills, the panic attacks
I keep sayin’ “tomorrow,” but that shit never lands

I’m tired of the guilt trips, the cheap tricks, the stomach flips
Of scrollin’ through pictures, half-wishin’ I could call her, but I’m stuck in this
I tried every twelve-step, fell off, came back, then I fell again
Every therapist quit, sayin’ “Marshall, you don’t wanna get well, man”

So I swallow it down with a handful of whatever’s left
I talk to God like he’s dodgin’ my texts
I know heaven ain’t takin’ requests, but hell feels too familiar to rest
And I’m trapped in this cycle, survival ain’t vital, just walkin’ in place, I’m a mess

My daughter’s birthday’s next week, she wants me clean
I got her gift in the trunk, wrapped up, with a note I won’t read
‘Cause I’m scared if I show up, I’ll ruin her dreams
Like her old man’s a joke, just a punchline between

These bars and the scars, and the stories I spin
Every line’s a confession, every verse is a binge
If you listen, you’ll hear the regret in my grin
But I keep runnin’ my mouth ‘cause I can’t keep it in

I miss when my problems were just rent and a beat
Now it’s syringes and seats at the group, and a priest
And I’m stuck in a loop, just repeat, just repeat
Tears in my notebook, these memories leak

Yeah, the photos are faded, but the pain’s in HD
I see her smile in the static of the TV
Replayin’ the moment she packed and she left me
Now I’m just beggin’ for someone to fix me

But I know I ain’t shit, I’m a punch to the chest
Tryna stitch up the mess, with a laugh and a threat
Every bottle I finish, another regret
If you call, I won’t answer, I’m lost in my head

This is more than a song, it’s a cry in the night
If you hear me, just know I’m still tryna get right
I ain’t lookin’ for pity, just someone to write
My story with ink that don’t smudge when I fight

[Outro | whispered outro | broken falsetto | detuned piano | tape hiss]
That’s it… that’s all I got left
If you find me tomorrow, hope I finally slept
Don’t play these old messages, just leave ‘em unread
And tell her I’m sorry, for all that I said
